Area-code-hunt shard B pass — NPAs 559, 562, 571

data.research_question: Which public organizations relevant to the anarchist-violence organization-enumeration corpus are discoverable from the next unresolved authoritative shard-B U.S. geographic NPAs 559, 562 and 571, and which public people have evidence-backed organizational roles?
data.method: Bounded area-code organization enumeration using current NANPA geographic-area-code admission before deterministic NPA mod 3 sharding; literal anarchist, anarchist collective, Anarchist Black Cross, Food Not Bombs and mutual-aid queries; locality-derived searches; first-party organization pages; public Linktree and event surfaces; Reddit discovery without official APIs; current-status checks; repository dedupe search; and public-person role enumeration from organization/team/publication evidence.
classification_rules: Do not infer individual political affiliation from organization role or proximity.
Do not label an organization anarchist absent explicit organization-level evidence.
Historical directories and old social endpoints are discovery seeds until current status is corroborated.
Do not merge identities from name, handle, locality or family similarity alone.
Keep inferred person-org relations distinguishable from explicit attributions.
Completed NPAs are not repeated without materially new evidence.

findings.notes: Current Saturday Fresno Food Not Bombs surface is retained separately from the self-labeled Sunday Chapter; Share Fresno is a late-2025 mutual-aid collective with 2026 status unresolved.
Long Beach Community Table is current first-party mutual aid; Long Beach Anarchist Collective is explicitly anarchist but 2026 activity remains unresolved.
Northern Virginia Mutual Aid is current with 2026 distributions and parent-page corroboration; La ColectiVA is current first-party abolitionist migrant-justice/community-care organizing.
